method.editWindow: 8 warmup; 24 edits per pass; rAF counted from immediately before the action through 120 ms settling and two additional callbacks; strict >16.700 ms rounded to nearest microsecond
method.stateProof: same block and edge IDs, coordinates, status, selection, endpoint, resolved graph size for each operation across all three routes
method.perDraw: one backend draw() wrapper for WebGL, one drawInterpreter() wrapper for Canvas; diagnostic phases collected separately
method.tagOnly: shared scene style tag; Canvas interpreter render recorded on every operation
method.timeline: two serial hardware passes per renderer and fixture in symmetric ordering, separate fresh browser per fixture
method.canvasDisclaimer: Measured actual ETL and Nirvana stories with their Canvas/GL paths. Fixed-time visual gold is previous WebGL, not cross-renderer pixel equivalence.
method.diagnostics: Eight additional edits per case with instrumentation installed. These timings do not contribute to the cadence samples.
method.threshold: Strictly greater than 16.700 ms after rounding each rAF interval to the nearest microsecond.
